verdict.rationale: MX documents a Platform API, with a published OpenAPI spec, for programmatically connecting end users. That API and the Connect Widget cover link sessions and connections, plus retrieving balances and 90 days to 24 months of accounts and transactions. A probe also found an official MCP server documented at docs.mx.com/mcp, and access uses API keys from the Client Dashboard with rotation. Missing for 10: evidence that credentials can be scoped or permission-limited for agents, any detail on which operations the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
